warmup_boundary: Warmup is one call. For these contracts that call only sets the initialized flag or performs local arithmetic, so it does not execute the state-changing subtraction. Continuation and symbolic suffixes start at the second call. This boundary was fixed before any scored repeat.
hit_definition: A hit is the first successful run(uint256) whose public count violates the fixture property. Warmup hits are shared. Symbolic hits require a Halmos model, a fresh Foundry replay, and a native Medusa replay with the same count. Excluded files and failed attempts stay out of the denominator.
symbolic_two_rule: One Halmos query solves the first suffix call. symbolic_two executes that same solved argument once more on the same instance. It does not solve a second argument and it does not insert the known value 2.
adaptive_rule: The frozen query cap is one. A model confirms the one-call suffix. No model is censored. Adaptive promotion does not invent a second argument when the single query has no model.
